Travel Notice for Animal Check-In

Travelers should review a few calm, practical points before heading to Aurelia Skyways with an animal companion. Our Companion Animal Travel Desk is keeping things steady and humane, and we want every traveler to feel ready at the counter.

Please make sure carriers are secure, clean, and easy for handlers to inspect. <<FACT F072>> We ask for clear spacing around the crate, soft bedding where allowed, and quiet handling so the animal can settle well. Please keep travel documents close at hand and follow any direction from our team without delay.

For larger pets, the desk will confirm the fee before acceptance. <<FACT F057>> This helps keep the process smooth and avoids surprises at check-in. If you are traveling with Mochi or another companion animal, our staff will guide you through the final steps with care.

Please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help before departure.
